errors.developer_api_unsupported_device: This EcoFlow device is not supported through the Developer API. Delete it and add it again using its dedicated EcoFlow device type.

stream_home_battery.title: Pair a STREAM Home Battery
stream_home_battery.intro: This represents one complete STREAM installation and provides whole-system totals for Homey Energy and widgets. Pair one per main system serial.

stream_unit.title: Pair a STREAM Unit
stream_unit.intro: This adds one inverter or battery as physical hardware. It does not provide whole-installation totals and is not used by Homey Energy or STREAM widgets. Pair STREAM Home Battery for the installation's combined energy data.

common.aggregate_required: Widgets use the complete installation, not a physical Unit.

battery_plan.title: Battery Plan
battery_plan.set_capacity: Set installed capacity in device settings
